claims.statement: The EU repair directive establishes obligations and information mechanisms promoting repair for covered goods while preserving legitimate intellectual-property protections.
EU ecodesign rules for household washing machines require specified spare-parts availability and repair-information access for qualifying professional repairers.

contrary_evidence: Repair-access rules are product-specific and allow competence, insurance, fee, safety, and IP conditions; they do not confer a right to republish OEM materials.

economics.acquisition_route: Parts wholesalers and repair associations bundle membership at ordering or training touchpoints
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Enroll 1000 technicians by year 3 (unvalidated), expand across Central Europe by year 6 (unvalidated), and support founder equity above PLN 5 million by year 7 (unvalidated)
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours per week during validation (unvalidated), with trade experts curating taxonomies
economics.gross_margin_basis: Member software, automated normalization, and contributor credits support 68-82% gross margin (unvalidated)
economics.pricing: PLN 120-250 per technician per month (unvalidated) and PLN 30000-120000 per governed reliability study (unvalidated)
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual memberships (unvalidated) with daily workflow embedding and repeated buyer studies

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Every verified repair and comeback sharpens model-specific diagnosis and parts-success evidence
fingerprint.customer: Independent appliance repairers, parts distributors, warranty administrators, refurbishers, and OEM reliability teams
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Diagnostic evidence membership funded by subscriptions and controlled reliability analyses
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Technician pays for workflow access; institutional buyer pays for an approved aggregate study
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A technician faces an uncertain diagnosis or a portfolio owner needs evidence on recurring failures

founder_fit: AI-supported classification and prediction are central.
Wholesaler distribution minimizes direct shop-by-shop selling.
Part-time software validation is possible before broad rollout.
risks: Noisy shop-entered data and weak workflow adoption.
OEM contractual or IP disputes if boundaries are poorly designed.
The stated PLN 80000 startup capital requirement is unvalidated.

structure.commercial_archetype: Member data guild with repair intelligence subscriptions and governed B2B analyses
structure.control_point: Licensed multi-brand corpus linking observed symptoms and measurements to actual parts, outcomes, and repeat failures
structure.critical_dependency: Shops must contribute consistent outcome data and lawfully access any protected repair information they use

thesis: Give independent appliance repair shops a structured diagnostic and quoting workflow in exchange for rights to pseudonymized fault signals, parts tried, repair outcome, time, and comeback data. Members receive cross-shop evidence; parts distributors, warranty administrators, and manufacturers buy governed reliability analyses. All OEM information is accessed only by eligible professional repairers under lawful terms, never by scraping or circumvention.
title: RepairOutcome Guild
uncertainties: Which repair category yields enough repeated cases for rapid usefulness?
Will wholesalers sponsor or distribute the guild?
